claim_ceiling: Finite-size closed U(1)-conserving qubit-chain diagnostics. Effective diffusion coefficient, butterfly-front speeds and entanglement velocity are circuit- and window-dependent fitted quantities. They are not gravitational black-hole transport coefficients or universal constants.

model.gate_family: independent Haar U(1) x U(2) x U(1) nearest-neighbour two-qubit gates

charge_transport.observable: ensemble-mean site occupations, bond currents and continuity residuals
charge_transport.density_gradient_width: Var of absolute density gradient |n_(i+1)-n_i| over bond-centre positions

operator_spreading.initial_operator: local Pauli X on source qubit 3
operator_spreading.probe: local Pauli Z on each site
operator_spreading.front: furthest site on each side with ensemble mean above a frozen threshold

entanglement.observable: von Neumann entropy of the left 4-qubit subsystem from the domain-wall quench
entanglement.normalization: exact symmetry-resolved Page mean for N=8,K=4,A=4

operator_spreading_ensembles.seed_schedule: first_seed(depth) = 0x0A70 + depth*101; each sample uses first_seed(depth)+sample_index

preregistered_run.status: contract_only; no Rust receipt at this branch head

fit_definitions.effective_charge_diffusion_coefficient: Half the least-squares slope of the density-gradient spatial variance versus brickwork layer
fit_definitions.left_butterfly_speed: Least-squares slope of left threshold-front distance from source versus depth
fit_definitions.right_butterfly_speed: Least-squares slope of right threshold-front distance from source versus depth
fit_definitions.effective_entanglement_velocity: Half-chain entropy slope in nats per layer divided by the exact symmetry-resolved Page mean in nats

negative_controls: fit D after the front reflects from a boundary without marking the finite-size regime
include threshold-front observations pinned to a boundary in vB regressions
change the OTOC threshold after seeing results and present it as preregistered
use the unconstrained Page mean for the fixed-charge half-chain normalization
infer a black-hole diffusion coefficient or Hawking transport law from this spin-chain experiment
assert a universal inequality between D, vB and vE from one small register
